ive been using this for a month and have noticed my smile lines which is what im mostly targeting have slowly been fading. LOVE this retinol booster! Works so well on my skin, I do not get irritation, have worked my way up to using almost every night. Even if it causes irritation (can be very normal, everyones sensitivity is different) try putting it over a layer of moisturizer and try only a couple times per week and then build up to every other day.
This is one of my current favorite HG products. I've been using it for 6 months, and it is really combating my wrinkles, especially around my mouth. I will keep buying this!

avis.titre: I love this product so much
avis.texte: I've been using the Celimax The Vita-A Retinal 0.1% Shot Booster and I really like it so far. It's lightweight, absorbs quickly, and feels gentle despite containing retinal. It helped improve my skin texture and made my complexion look smoother and clearer over time. No major irritation, but I still recommend starting slowly and using sunscreen.

This made a huge improvement in a very short time. I noticed right off the bat it was working and making me look better. Very smooth going on and invisible going on. I just rubbed in a tiny amount and it really works on my face the way its suppose too. Great product.

This is my first time trying a retinal product and this is a beginner friendly version for those nervous about testing out the new "shot" skincare technology. The feeling is very minimal and I've noticed it reducing the fine lines around my nose.
It's lightweight and works well with the soothing ampoule. I used it every night and after 2 weeks I noticed that my skin feels better. Especially with the texture.
omg! it really works. don't sleep on this product and stock up.

Thecelimax The Vita-A Retinal 0.1% Shot Booster Treatment feels like a powerful yet surprisingly gentle addition to a nighttime routine. The texture is smooth and absorbs quickly, without leaving a greasy or heavy feeling on the skin. This has quickly become my favorite retinal product. I noticed visible results right after the first use - fine lines looked smoother, and my skin tone appeared more even. With continued use, my skin looks more refined and balanced, and the overall texture keeps improving. I can only imagine how much more noticeable the results will be after a full month, especially in smoothing deeper lines and evening out skin texture. Even though it contains retinal, it doesn't feel overly harsh when used properly, especially with a good moisturizer. A great option if you're looking to step up your skincare routine and target uneven texture and dullness.

I like that it doesn't irritate my skin. Compared to other retinal cream I've used, this one feels smooth on my face, and doesn't sting. I have been using it every other day for three weeks, and it's been going well.

Product is bright yellow like most retinols. It is not too thick and dries quickly so you can layer without it moving around. I did avoid my areas with roseacea and used it around my mouth and on my forehead. Zero tingling and burning. I can't rate it on its effectiveness yet but I will say I had zero reaction so I am happy to continue using it.

I love this booster shot. It has a great texture and it is doing wonders on my fine lines. I noticed my fine lines are smoother and you dont need much of the product while applying. I also use on my pores and my pores look so much smaller and smooth

I have been using this for about a week now and I see signs of this being effective. The formulation is in the consistency of a cream, dispense through a narrow nozzel. The tube seems to be made of plastic instead of aluminium (so, it returns to it's original shape instead of getting constricted with each pump). I like the consistency and am seeing my laugh lines improving.

I've been using this retinal for around two weeks and I think it may be my new favorite retinal/retinol product. I've used quite a few different brands, but this one seems to work quicker and more effectively than the other ones I've tried. My skin pretty immediately looked brighter, smoother, and glowier. It's gentle enough for me to use every night, but if you're new to retinal I would definitely work up slowly. The packaging is super convenient and chic, and overall I'm just highly impressed! I received this product in exchange for my honest review.

I started using this about 2 weeks ago to try and help with my fine lines that have been recently developing. It goes on smooth, doesn't have any pilling, no sticky or tacky residue and seems to be helping to tighten my skin and aid in the fine lines.

Initially picked this up at a Korean skincare popup in NYC but gave it to my mom because I heard great reviews for anti-aging. She loved it! I finally got the chance to try it myself and am also a big fan. It doesn't dry out my skin as much as prescription retinol and it's super easy to spread across my face. I've also been using it on my neck and am excited to see results. Skin feels super smooth and lightweight after. Excited to continue using!

avis.titre: Second Tube and Still Loving It!
avis.texte: I'm 39 and very worried about getting wrinkles, so I'm always looking for products that really work. I'm already on my second tube of Celimax THE VITA-A Retinal Shot Tightening Booster and I love it. I use it on my forehead (especially between my eyebrows), under my eyes, and on my nasolabial lines, and the difference is noticeable. My skin looks smoother and those areas look softer. Definitely recommend it if you're concerned about fine lines and wrinkles like me.
I've been using it for about a week my skin is looking better it is lightweight and hydrating has no smell you do feel a little sting because of the retinal but that is normal
Been using it for about it 2 weeks and I notice my skin is more glowy and plump looking 👍

my skin looks firmer and looks smoother, fines lines have smoother and overall my skin texture looks better, I have used retinal before but haven't accomplished the results the Celimax The Vita-A Retinal Booster gave my skin, it doesn't irritate or got sensitive skin after using it, my skin feels hydrated and glowy after 2 weeks of use.

Very gently effective. The non-irritating formula feels silky and high-end. My skin is noticeably refreshed and firmed. The pore tightening effect is evident through a more smooth and uniform skin appearance. The ingredients are beneficial without causing any drying of more delicate facial areas. My skin feels smooth and refreshed after using and I appreciate the precision applicator tip for targeting specific spots

I just got Celimax Retinal Shot Tightening Booster and have been using it at night for about a week now, focusing on my forehead and a few targeted lines. It has a yellow creamy texture and is easy to apply. It blends and absorbs well into my skin. I feel a slight tingle upon application and it doesn't leave a sticky residue. So far my skin feels smoother and firmer and can't wait to see more results once I've used it longer. I do wish it came in a bigger container.

I noticed firmer skin tone after using this for about a week. It absorbs quickly and completely with no burning or irritation. My skin feels tighter and firmer than before I started using this retinol shot. I recommend this to anybody looking to tone facial skin.

I really enjoyed this product! Not only has it lightened my dark spots, but I've also noticed it has reduced my fine lines and smile lines significantly. I also noticed it cleared a lot of the little acne and bumps I get. You only need to use a little at night and use it continuously to get quick results.

I've been using this tightening booster at night and I really like it. The lotion is light and not greasy, so it goes on easy and doesn't feel heavy under my moisturizer. It has 0.1% retinal, plus ingredients like peptides and niacinamide that help smooth my fine lines, make my skin firmer, and brighten my face. I haven't had the irritation I usually get from regular retinol. After a few weeks my skin looks smoother and my pores seem smaller. I started using it every other night so my skin could get used to it, and I didn't get any redness or peeling. Make sure to wear sunscreen during the day because retinal can make your skin more sensitive to sun. I like the tube and the tip allows for pinpoint application so I don't waste the product. I also like the tube because I'm not sticking my fingers in a jar over and overr. I didn't detect any fragrance so if there is one, it's very light I really appreciate skincare that is fragrance free Or has a light fragrance. So far, I'm very impressed with this brand and I can't wait to try other products from their line. I definitely recommend. This is good for anyone who wants anti-aging results but finds regular retinol too strong. I would tell friends to try it if they want firmer, younger-looking skin without irritation. I was gifted this product and exchange for my honest review

I love this product!!!! Thank you so much for giving me the opportunity to try it!!! I would love to try more samples and leave reviews!!! This product helped me so much!!!!!! I definitely will be purchasing once I use this one all up!! I can't wait!!!!
